passives.name: Focus
passives.description: Basic attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to minions.

passives.name: Endure
passives.description: When an enemy champion damages you, restore up to 45 health over 8s - more the lower your health is (66% for ranged champions and against area or periodic damage).

effects.amount: 45 * missing_hp / max_hp * (1 - 0.34 * int(ranged or is_aoe or is_dot)) / 8
